name: Light Spring
headline: Airy warmth with delicate brightness
jewelry: Light yellow gold, peach pearls, warm ivory enamel, and airy translucent stones.
rationale: Light Spring is chosen when the coloring reads warm, fresh, and lower in contrast, with brightness that still needs to stay delicate.

name: True Spring
headline: Sunny warmth with lively saturation
jewelry: Polished yellow gold, warm pearls, citrine, peridot, and coral-toned accents.
rationale: True Spring appears when warmth and clarity both score high, especially when the features look animated by golden color rather than softened neutrals.

name: Bright Spring
headline: High clarity with sparkling warm-neutral energy
jewelry: Shiny yellow gold, polished rose gold, bright enamel, and crisp high-shine stones.
rationale: Bright Spring wins when the scoring finds both chroma and contrast at the clear end, while the undertone stays warm or warm-neutral.

name: Warm Spring
headline: Golden warmth with sunlit mid-depth
jewelry: Yellow gold, bronze, warm rose gold, citrine, amber, and golden freshwater pearls.
rationale: Warm Spring is selected when golden undertone is the dominant clue and the rest of the coloring supports moderate clarity instead of extreme softness or contrast.

name: Light Summer
headline: Cool lightness with watercolor softness
jewelry: Silver, white gold, rose pearl, moonstone, and low-shine cool metals.
rationale: Light Summer rises when the scoring sees cool-leaning undertone, low contrast, and light feature depth with a softened finish.

name: True Summer
headline: Cool blue balance with refined softness
jewelry: Brushed silver, white gold, rose quartz, amethyst, and cool pearls.
rationale: True Summer is the cool and softened anchor of the Summer family, favored when blue-based temperature and moderate contrast score together.

name: Soft Summer
headline: Muted cool-neutral harmony
jewelry: Antiqued silver, pewter, muted rose gold, labradorite, and gray pearls.
rationale: Soft Summer is selected when muted chroma is the strongest signal and the temperature leans cool without demanding icy contrast.

name: Cool Summer
headline: Blue-cool color with graceful definition
jewelry: Silver, white gold, platinum, sapphire, garnet, and blue-toned pearls.
rationale: Cool Summer wins when cool undertone is clear and the rest of the features sit at controlled, medium contrast rather than Winter intensity.

name: Soft Autumn
headline: Muted warmth with earthy polish
jewelry: Antique gold, brushed bronze, warm pewter, amber, jade, and smoky quartz.
rationale: Soft Autumn is chosen when warmth is present but softened by muted chroma, olive-neutral undertone, and gentle contrast.

name: True Autumn
headline: Rich golden earth tones
jewelry: Yellow gold, bronze, copper, amber, tiger eye, and warm mixed metals.
rationale: True Autumn is the warm earthy center, selected when golden undertone, medium depth, and grounded saturation all agree.

name: Dark Autumn
headline: Deep warmth with dramatic earthiness
jewelry: Deep yellow gold, bronze, blackened gold, garnet, amber, and smoky topaz.
rationale: Dark Autumn rises when the coloring has depth and contrast, but the undertone and best neutrals stay warm, rich, and earthy.

name: Warm Autumn
headline: Copper warmth with saturated spice
jewelry: Copper, yellow gold, bronze, amber, citrine, and warm green stones.
rationale: Warm Autumn is selected when strong golden warmth pairs with richer spice tones and more saturation than Soft or True Autumn.

name: Dark Winter
headline: Deep cool-neutral contrast
jewelry: Silver, white gold, gunmetal, black diamond, garnet, and deep sapphire.
rationale: Dark Winter wins when the feature depth and contrast are high, while the undertone points cool-neutral rather than golden.

name: True Winter
headline: Pure cool contrast with crisp color
jewelry: Platinum, silver, white gold, diamonds, clear crystals, and saturated cool gems.
rationale: True Winter is selected when cool temperature, sharp contrast, and crisp chroma all score strongly together.

name: Bright Winter
headline: Electric clarity with cool-neutral contrast
jewelry: High-shine silver, white gold, patent enamel, crystal, emerald, and cool bright stones.
rationale: Bright Winter rises when the clearest, highest contrast cues dominate and the temperature is cool-neutral rather than golden.

name: Cool Winter
headline: Blue-cool depth with polished intensity
jewelry: Silver, platinum, white gold, hematite, ruby, sapphire, and cool polished stones.
rationale: Cool Winter is chosen when the scores point clearly cool and high contrast, but slightly less neon clarity than Bright or True Winter.
